mapper.select: SELECT a.org02_info_id AS info_id, a.org02_code_id AS code_id, a.org02_parent_code_id AS parent_code_id, a.org02_mod_date::date AS mod_date, a.org02_mod_reason AS mod_reason, a.org02_kor_nm AS kor_nm, a.org02_eng_nm AS eng_nm, a.org02_level_cd AS level_cd, f_cdnm('OrgLevelCode', org02_level_cd, org01_company_id, org02_mod_date) AS level_nm, a.org02_sort_order AS sort_order, a.org02_note AS note FROM org02_info a , org01_code b WHERE 1=1 AND org02_code_id = #{codeId} AND org01_code_id = org02_code_id ORDER BY org02_mod_date DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM org02_info INNER JOIN org01_code ON org01_code_id = org02_code_id WHERE org02_parent_code_id = #{codeId}
